title: validateEnvVars checks presence only, and its list does not match the code: 18 keys the code reads are not registered (the per-chain MIN_LIQUIDITY, tax and honeypot-checker keys, DASHBOARD_HOST/PORT), MIN_LIQUIDITY is also missing from .env.example, and some registered keys are read nowhere

evidence.note: validateEnvVars: only spec.required && !process.env[name]; no type, range or format check for any key
reads <PREFIX>_MIN_LIQUIDITY, _HONEYPOT_CHECKER_ADDRESS, _MAX_BUY_TAX_BPS, _MAX_SELL_TAX_BPS for four prefixes, none registered

evidence.ref: node diff script in the scratch folder over git show <sha>:.env.example, the snapshot config.ts and git grep -ho "process.env.[A-Z_0-9]*" <sha> -- src (template keys expanded for ETH/BSC/BASE/ARB)
evidence.note: read by code but not registered: ETH/BSC/BASE/ARB_MIN_LIQUIDITY, _HONEYPOT_CHECKER_ADDRESS, _MAX_BUY_TAX_BPS, _MAX_SELL_TAX_BPS, DASHBOARD_HOST, DASHBOARD_PORT; read by code but not in .env.example: the four _MIN_LIQUIDITY keys; registered and in .env.example but read nowhere: MEV_MAX_PRIORITY_FEE_GWEI, RPC_TIMEOUT_MS, MEV_BUY/SELL_COINBASE_BRIBE_ENABLED (AUD-TX-010, TH-TX-05/-20/-26)
TELEGRAM_API_ID/HASH/SESSION are optional here (rule applies only if API_ID is set) but required: true in config.ts:20-22

sibling_sites_checked: Diff computed over all of src at the base SHA; regex-only hits that are not reads (preflight.ts:63 comment process.env.X, :715 comment MEV_STRATEGY, NODE_ENV) were removed, and MEV_CONFIRM_* / MEV_*_GWEI keys read through a passed env object in reconciliation.ts (TX slice) were checked by hand and are read. FLASHBOTS_AUTH_KEY / BLOXROUTE_AUTH_HEADER are required:false here and enforced per chain at chainRegistry.ts:948-955.
severity_rationale: S3: the canonical env list and the template do not describe what the bot reads (D-ENV-EXAMPLE drift); the money-relevant consequence (non-numeric values accepted) is RC-06 / AUD-DB-001 and is graded there.
recommendation: Generate the env list from one typed schema that the parsers use (key, type, range, default, required-when), add a sync test against .env.example (22-05 already syncs test/.env.test with .env.example), and drop or wire the dead keys. Card DB-06. Phase 27/29.
